about: zui's default design. Every color is resolved by zui_design's own math (OKLCH ramps, gamut mapping by chroma, sRGB byte rounding, APCA 0.0.98G-4g, WCAG 2), so resolved[...] is what zui_design.resolve must produce once tones[...] and roles[...] land.

monospace.preview_note: Cousine is metric-compatible with Liberation Mono and stands in for it in this page.

background.use: The window's page, behind every surface.

surface.use: Cards, sheets, list rows and fields at rest.

surface_raised.use: Elevation 1: a card or a control lifted off its surface.

surface_sunken.use: Wells: a track, a code block, a segmented control's groove.

surface_overlay.use: Elevation 2 and up: menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts, the command palette.

surface_inverse.use: Tooltips and snackbars, which stand out by inverting.

on_surface_muted.use: Secondary text: descriptions, timestamps, placeholders, captions.

on_surface_accent.use: Accent-colored text and icons on a surface: links, a selected tab's label, a tertiary button.

accent.use: The primary button, a checked box, a switch's on track, a slider's fill.

accent_container.use: A tonal button, a selected chip, the current day, an info banner.

secondary_container.use: A secondary button, a hovered row's tint, a neutral badge, a segmented control's thumb in dark.

danger.use: A destructive button, an error badge's dot.

danger_container.use: An error banner, toast or field message's tint.

success.use: A success badge, an online dot, a confirming button.

selection.use: Selected text, selected table rows and the drag-reorder drop slot.

outline.use: Field borders, unchecked boxes and radios, a switch's off thumb ring.

outline_muted.use: Dividers and the hairline around a card where no shadow is drawn.

scrim.use: Behind a dialog or a drawer.

shadow.use: Every elevation's shadow color; each level gives its own alpha.

rim.use: The 1-unit border on a raised or overlay surface: a dark crisp edge in light, a lit edge in dark.

focus_ring.corner: the part's radius plus the offset
focus_ring.shown: only after keyboard navigation, never on a click or tap

metrics.touch_rule: Under Preferences.pointer = .touch every control height is at least 44, and its padding is unchanged.

elevation.note: zui draws one shadow per element, so each level is one shadow, tuned to read as a two-layer one. Its color is the shadow role with the level's alpha. A rim is a 1-unit border in the rim role.

levels.use: Cards, a raised control, a segmented control's thumb, a switch's thumb
Menus, popovers, a dropdown's list, tooltips
The command palette, a dragged item

light_vs_dark: In light, height reads from the shadow, and every raised surface is white; the rim is a 7% dark edge that keeps white-on-near-white crisp.

In dark, a shadow barely shows against a dark page, so each level is also a lighter surface (surface 0.218, raised 0.252, overlay 0.282 in OKLCH lightness), and the rim is a 7.5% light edge, like light catching a bevel.
Dark shadows are about three times as opaque as light ones for the same geometry.

motion.reduced_motion: Every tween and spring lands at once (zui_motion's own rule). Opacity fades shorter than 0.2 s are kept as cross-fades; movement and scale are dropped.

state.use: Color changes between idle, hovered, focused and pressed

press.use: Buttons, chips, cards that act as buttons: scaled about their center while pressed

toggle.use: A switch's thumb, a segmented control's thumb, a slider's thumb on a click

check.use: A checkbox's mark and a radio's dot, scaled from 0.6 with opacity

popover_enter.use: Menus, popovers, dropdown lists, tooltips; scaled from the edge they open from

reorder.use: Rows moving aside for a dragged row

disclosure.use: The chevron turns 90 degrees; the content's height follows

skeleton_shimmer.use: A highlight sweeps across; under reduced motion the skeleton holds still

personalities.name: Quiet instrument
personalities.summary: For tools and pro apps: tight, outlined, almost no color until something is selected.

personalities.name: Soft tonal
personalities.summary: The default: tonal fills instead of lines, continuous corners, comfortable air.

skin.inputs: surface_sunken fill, no border until focused

personalities.name: Crisp technical
personalities.summary: For dashboards and makers: chamfered corners, mono numbers and labels, a vivid accent saved for focus and selection.

skin.inputs: surface_sunken with an outline bottom edge
skin.labels: label role drawn in the monospace font, uppercase, +6% tracking

components.name: Button

tertiary.background: transparent; secondary_container when hovered or pressed

components.states: Each fill takes its resolved hovered, focused and pressed layer. Pressed also scales to 0.97 (motion.press). Disabled takes the disabled layer and draws no shadow.

components.name: Icon button
components.states: The accessible label is required and is the tooltip's text.

components.name: Link

text.underline: 1 unit, 2 below the baseline, at 40% alpha; full alpha when hovered

components.states: Opens through HostRequests.open_url. Focus ring wraps the text with offset 2 and corner sharp.

components.name: Checkbox
components.states: Indeterminate draws a 10 x 2 bar in on_accent. The whole row is the target.

components.name: Radio group
components.keyboard: Arrow keys move the selection and focus together; Tab leaves the group.

track.background: outline_muted when off, accent when on

thumb.background: surface_raised when on, outline when off

label.position: leading; the switch is trailing in a settings row

components.name: Slider

thumb.hovered: a 6-unit halo in accent at 16% alpha

ticks.color: on_accent on the filled track, outline on the empty

components.keyboard: Arrows step; Page Up and Down step by 10; Home and End.

components.name: Text field

container.border: none at rest; outline_muted when hovered

container_focused.border: accent, 2 (drawn inside, so text does not move)

caret.blink: 0.53 s on, 0.53 s off, solid for 0.5 s after each edit

components.states: The field shows the focus ring only when reached by keyboard; a click shows the accent border alone.

container.note: as text_field; grows with its lines between min_lines and max_lines, then scrolls

components.name: Search field
components.keyboard: Escape clears, then a second Escape leaves.

components.name: Number stepper
components.states: Dragging the value sideways scrubs: one step per 4 units, the pointer hidden while it scrubs. At a limit its button is disabled.
components.keyboard: Up and Down step; typing replaces the value.

components.name: Dropdown
components.api: widgets.dropdown(ui, id, options, *usize) bool / widgets.dropdownEnum(ui, id, *Enum) bool

option.corner: smooth (popup radius minus its padding: nested)

indeterminate.note: slides with ease_in_out; reduced motion shows a static 30% fill pulsing in opacity

components.name: Spinner
components.states: Reduced motion: three dots fading in turn.

block.corner: sharp for text lines, image for images, indicator for avatars

shimmer.color: surface at 60% alpha in light, surface_overlay at 60% in dark

text.color: on_surface; tone .muted is on_surface_muted; tone .accent is on_surface_accent

components.name: Labeled row
components.states: In a settings list, rows sit on one card with dividers between them, not one card each.

initials.rule: first letters of the first and last word

fallback_colors.background: accent_container at the hue hashed from the name, from the eight accent presets

presence.colors: success online, warning away, outline offline

components.name: Card

media.corner: container on the top corners, square on the bottom

components.states: An interactive card: hovered raises to elevation 2, pressed scales to 0.985 and drops to elevation 1.

label.note: a centered label breaks the line

components.name: Scroll area

thumb.color: on_surface at 28% alpha; 44% when hovered; 56% while dragged

track.color: none; on_surface at 6% alpha while hovered

edge_fade.note: a fade into the surface at an edge that has more content beyond it

components.states: Thumbs fade out 0.8 s after scrolling stops, unless the pointer is over the track. Momentum scrolling follows the host.

body.note: rows inside are labeled_rows with dividers

components.name: Tabs

tab.color: on_surface_muted; on_surface when hovered; on_surface_accent when selected

pill_style.note: style .pill reuses the segmented control's groove and thumb

components.keyboard: Arrow keys move focus; Enter or Space selects; Home and End.

overflow.rule: past four crumbs the middle ones collapse into a menu button

components.name: Tooltip
components.states: Appears after 0.5 s of hover, at once if another tooltip closed in the last 0.3 s, and on keyboard focus. No arrow.

components.name: Menu and context menu
components.api: widgets.menu(ui, id, anchor) / widgets.menuItem(ui, id, label, .{ .shortcut, .icon, .checked, .danger }) bool / widgets.contextMenu(ui, region_id)

check.column: a leading column reserved when any item is checkable

components.states: A submenu opens after 0.2 s of hover and stays open while the pointer moves toward it. A context menu opens at the pointer, flipped to fit the window.
components.keyboard: Arrows, Enter, Escape, Right opens a submenu, Left closes it, typing a letter jumps.

components.name: Popover
components.states: Flips to the opposite side when it would leave the window. Escape or a click outside closes it and returns focus to the anchor.

components.name: Dialog

actions.order: cancel then confirm; the confirm button is primary or danger

components.states: Traps focus; focuses the first field, or the confirm button. On a phone-sized window it becomes a bottom sheet with container corners on the top only.

components.name: Toast

panel.position: bottom center, xl above the edge

action.underline: 1 unit at 40% alpha; full when hovered

stack.note: older toasts shrink by 4% each and tuck behind

components.states: Stays 5 s, paused while hovered or focused. Announced to assistive technology.

dot.note: a badge with no text is a dot, ring 2 in the surface beneath

components.name: Chip

close.hovered: a circle in secondary_container behind it

components.states: Selection animates the check in with motion.check; the chip widens to fit it with motion.toggle.

emphasis.note: drawn as body_strong in on_surface_accent: the bundled fonts have no italic

inline_code.type: code at 0.92 of the body size

components.name: Reorderable list

handle.target: the whole row on touch after a 0.3 s hold

components.keyboard: Space picks a row up, arrows move it, Space drops, Escape cancels; each move is announced.

parts.virtualized: Only visible rows are declared; the row height is fixed per density.

components.name: Tree
components.keyboard: Arrows navigate; Right expands, Left collapses or goes to the parent; asterisk expands siblings.

components.name: Split pane
components.keyboard: The divider is focusable; arrows move it by 16.

overflow.rule: items that do not fit move into a trailing menu

shortcut.component: keycap: label in on_surface_muted on surface_sunken, corner sharp, padding xs

plane.note: OKLCH: chroma across, lightness up, at the chosen hue; gamut edge drawn as a 1 line

handle.border: white 2 with a 1 shadow ring in shadow at 40%

fields.component: text_field small, hex and OKLCH, numeric type

range.note: the band runs between the ends with square inner corners

field.component: text_field with a trailing calendar icon_button
segmented hour and minute fields, numeric type, each edited by typing or arrows

list.component: dropdown popup of times at step_minutes, the nearest scrolled into view

message.note: "Drop photos here or choose files", with choose files a link

changed_marker.note: beside a value changed from its default

log_levels.error: on_danger_container on danger_container for the level tag

follow_tail_button.component: chip shown when scrolled up from the end: "Jump to latest"

grid.count: 4 to 6 horizontal lines at round values

series_colors.rule: the accent first, then the accent presets in the order violet, teal, amber, rose, green; at most six series, more is a table

bar.corner: sharp on the top corners only

tooltip.component: tooltip with a swatch per series

port.color: the edge's type color or outline

resolver_changes.change: Add twelve roles: surface_overlay, on_surface_accent, danger_container, on_danger_container, warning_container, on_warning_container, success_container, on_success_container, selection, on_selection, shadow, rim.
Each new role's partner, kind and tier, as roles[...] in the export gives them. shadow and rim are kind scrim: never layered, never greyed when disabled.
Replace the four schemes' tables with tones[...] in the export.
Exempt shadow and rim from reduced_transparency_alpha, which would otherwise raise a 7% rim to 85%.
Add label_strong (step -1, strong font), and draw title, headline and display in the strong font.

Add control heights (small, medium, large) and icon sizes per density, the focus ring's offset, and elevation levels 1 to 4 (surface role, rim, shadow offset, blur, spread and alpha per scheme), resolved like spacing.

resolver_changes.where: core/zui_design: a new default.zig, exported as zui_design.default
resolver_changes.change: The Design in design[...] of the export, with fonts left for the application to fill from its FontIds.
